row.answer: Pantheon is a fighter and assassin focused on physical damage and AD. He leaps onto a target to stun them, uses empowered abilities, and blocks frontal damage with his shield.
row.counterplay: Keep distance from his leap and save damage for when his shield ends or you can attack from another direction.
